verdict.rationale: Scribe's batch mode lets a user submit jobs of up to 10,000 files from S3 prefixes or manifests. Those jobs then run asynchronously through QUEUED/PROCESSING/SUCCEEDED states, and Zoom sends a signed webhook POST when each job finishes, so the work does run in the background without supervision. However, these are one-off submitted jobs, not configurable automations: nothing shows scheduled runs, recurring triggers, or automatic pickup of new files. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring automation setup, event-triggered pipelines (e.g., auto-transcribe new uploads), automation management UI or config, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
